change.title: Change
change.handHint: Tap or drag cash from the drawer here
change.lowHint: red number = running low on small change

qris.slow: The signal is slow. This will take a moment.
qris.unverified: Cannot check the payment ({{reason}}). Their screen says it worked.
qris.trustHint: If it was fake you only find out when the phone can check again.

kasbon.note: Unpaid kasbon right now: {{owed}}. Forgotten debts can be lost.

walkaway.patience: A customer left after waiting too long
walkaway.qris_refused: Payment could not be checked, the customer left

toast.turnedAway: The line is full, a customer went home

toast.unplannedClosure: Closed without planning: regulars are disappointed, reputation dropped a little
toast.orderLate: An order is late, arriving tomorrow
toast.wentStale: {{item}}: {{portions}} portions went stale and were thrown out

ramadan.now: Ramadan starts today: few come by day, the evening rush is big (takjil, es teh, gorengan)
ramadan.soon: Ramadan starts in {{n}} days: expect an evening rush and quiet days

mudik.now: Mudik season: many neighbours have left town
mudik.soon: Mudik season in {{n}} days: the street will thin out

lebaran.now: Lebaran: most shops are shut and visitors want kue and drinks

new-year.now: New Year: late-night crowd wants smokes and water

independence.now: 17 Agustus: the street is busy all day

long-weekend.now: Long weekend: fewer people around, more evening snackers

toast.tokenOut: The electricity token ran out. Power is off
toast.qrisTrusted: Took their word for the QRIS payment

title.tagline: Thin margins, costs that move on their own, and a life that does not stop when the shop closes.

1.name: Opening the Warung
1.desc: The first week of the shop. The counter and customer types.

2.name: Prices Rise
2.desc: Ingredient prices climb. The first power outage.

3.name: Busy Kitchen
3.desc: A big order from the neighborhood. Cooking and stock.

home.title: Before opening
home.dayShape: Shape of a day: before opening, shop open, free time
home.hint: If the shelves are not stocked when you open, you can still stock them while serving. Customers wait meanwhile.

siapkan.name: Prepare the shop
siapkan.desc: Full shelves, stocked fridge, prices checked. 90 minutes.

tukar.name: Exchange cash
tukar.desc: Swap big notes for small change at a shop. 30 minutes, 2% fee.

ojol.name: Drive ojol
ojol.desc: A little extra, fuel costs money.

tidur.name: Sleep in
tidur.desc: Rest longer. Stock the shelves while serving.

exchange.title: Exchange cash
exchange.help: Swap big notes from the drawer for small ones at a nearby shop. It takes {{minutes}} minutes of the pre-open block and costs {{fee}}%.

summary.title: The shop is closed. Here is how it went.
summary.notYet: No summary yet. It appears once the shop closes.
summary.profitSub: After {{cost}} of ingredients and {{fees}} of QRIS fees
summary.qrisPending: QRIS taken on trust, not checked yet: {{amount}}

phone.title: Phone
phone.soon: Phone apps arrive in later phases: chat, bank, ojol, market, planner, ledger.
phone.help: The battery only drains while the power is out. Data is used by the market app and by checking QRIS. Data packs are paid in cash from the drawer.

off.title: Day off
off.desc: The shop is closed. There are 4 blocks. Each holds one heavy activity or two light ones.
off.hint: Time only moves when you run a block. After the evening block comes free time, 22.00–24.00.

tomorrow.title: Open tomorrow?
tomorrow.openPlanned: The shop opens 07.00–22.00. Pre-open starts at 05.00.
tomorrow.openOnDayOff: You are working on a day off. No penalty, but no rest either.
tomorrow.closedUnplanned: Closing when it was not planned costs a little reputation, because regulars expect the shop to be open.
tomorrow.closedPlanned: A planned day off, so no penalty. Tomorrow has 4 blocks of activities.

planner.title: Weekly plan
planner.rule: At most {{max}} days off a week, no minimum. Tap a day to switch between work and off.
planner.blockHint: Dashed = heavy activity (one per block). The rest are light (two per block).

save.confirm: A new game replaces this save. The old save is kept as a backup.
save.invalid: Its data is damaged or not recognised. Starting a new game keeps it as a backup.
save.newer: This save was made by a newer version of the game. Starting a new game keeps it as a backup.
save.outdated: This save was made before the market existed and does not hold enough to continue. Starting a new game keeps it as a backup.

menu.title: Menu & prices
menu.help: The cost per portion is worked out from today's ingredient prices, so it moves with the market.

storage.title: Storage
storage.fridgeHelp: Things that spoil fast go in the fridge while there is room. The oldest stock gets the space first.
storage.freezerHold: Keeps its cold {{hours}} hours in a power cut. A full day ({{full}} h) once it is at least {{pct}}% full.
storage.freezerBuyHelp: A freezer keeps chicken for about a month and holds ice. It is also the only place for frozen goods: ice cream, nuggets, sausages, meatballs and dim sum. A long power cut can ruin everything in it.

pasar.title: Market
pasar.soon: from tomorrow or the day after
pasar.tripBanner: You are at the pasar today.
pasar.tripBannerHelp: Market prices with haggling, a bulk discount on big buys, and you carry it home right away.
pasar.tripHelp: Haggling can move the price up or down by as much as {{pct}}%. Big buys get a bulk discount.
pasar.noFunds: Not enough in the bank. Withdraw or deposit in the Bank app first.
pasar.expressHelp: A rider brings it within hours. Costs {{fee}}. For emergencies.
pasar.cutoffHint: Order before {{time}} to get it tomorrow. After that it arrives the day after.
pasar.belowMin: The order is below this supplier's minimum ({{min}}).
pasar.cartEmpty: The basket is empty. Pick goods in the Prices or Goods tab.

news.harvest-failure: Chili harvest failed at the source. Chili prices jump, {{starts}}.
news.fuel-hike: Fuel prices rise. Goods and delivery costs follow, {{starts}}.
news.flood: Flooding where the suppliers are. Greens go up and deliveries may run late, {{starts}}.
news.lpg-shortage: 3 kg LPG is scarce at the retailers. The price rises, {{starts}}.
news.market-operation: A government market operation. Rice and cooking oil get cheaper, {{starts}}.

pasar.noPhone: The phone is dead. Charge it or use a powerbank.
pasar.noData: Out of mobile data. Top up on the phone screen.
pasar.needsFreezer: Frozen goods need a freezer. Buy one in the storeroom first.
pasar.freezerTight: The freezer may not have room: what does not fit when it arrives melts.

news.title: News
news.none: No news yet. The radio will warn you when prices are about to move.

morning.title: This morning
morning.late: Order #{{n}} from {{supplier}} is late. It arrives {{weekday}}.

bankApp.title: Bank
bankApp.help: QRIS money lands here, not in the drawer. Orders from the phone and trips to the pasar are paid from this balance.
bankApp.withdrawHelp: The machine only pays out big notes, so this does not add small change. For small change, exchange cash before opening.

token.title: Electricity token
token.help: Open hours burn credit, and the fridge and lights use some every night. At zero the power goes out and the fridge warms up.

bills.title: Bills
bills.overdue: Overdue: late fee {{fee}} and reputation drops every night
bills.early: You can pay from {{n}} days before the due date

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.help: Cook ahead so the display is full when you open. Food left on the display too long goes stale and is thrown out.
kitchen.cooking: Cooking, the counter has to wait
kitchen.closed: The kitchen can only be used before and during opening hours

cookWhy.no_ice: No ice while the power is out

kitchen.orderDishesHelp: These are made from the storeroom when a customer orders.
kitchen.batchSale: An empty display means lost sales. Do not send customers home.
kitchen.prepareNote: Preparing the shelves takes {{minutes}} of these minutes.

gas.title: Gas
gas.help: Every dish burns some LPG. A tank from next door costs more than the market and takes {{minutes}} minutes.

leftovers.title: Left on the display
leftovers.help: Anything you do not deal with tonight is thrown out tomorrow morning.

stove.title: Stove
stove.hint: Tap a dish to put it on the stove, then lift it while the bar is green.

outage.fridge: The fridge will not hold that long. Buy ice or expect spoilage tonight.
outage.icy: Ice bought: the fridge holds and cold drinks work.
outage.lantern: Lantern ready: evening customers still come.
outage.tokenEmpty: The electricity token ran out. Power is off
outage.dataLow: Mobile data is almost gone: {{mb}} MB
outage.freezer: The freezer will not hold that long. Frozen goods and chicken may be ruined tonight.

titipan.title: Titipan
titipan.help: A neighbour lets you sell their kue basah and nasi bungkus. You pay only for what sells, and what is left goes back at closing. The margin is smaller, but you cannot lose money on it.
titipan.locked: A neighbour will offer titipan from day {{day}}.
titipan.perks: You can take up to {{max}} of each item. Terms are {{pct}}% better than the standard price.
titipan.trustHelp: A day when at least half of what you took sells builds trust. Taking a lot and selling almost none costs it.
titipan.owedHelp: The bank could not cover the last settlement. Pay before taking more.
titipan.onlyBeforeOpen: Titipan can only be picked up before opening. Unsold pieces go back when you close.
titipan.terms: You pay {{cost}}, you sell for {{price}}, margin {{margin}}
titipan.minutes: Each pickup takes {{minutes}} minutes of the pre-open block.

why.titipan_full: You have taken as much as you can today
